title: Prove the sharp four-qubit Clifford tensor threshold T(4)=13
body:
**Scoped native-algebra theorem: the full Gaussian-dyadic four-qubit Clifford alphabet is pointwise tensor-independent exactly at widths f >= 13. Thus T(4)=13.** Width eleven has exact nullity 2,733,412,864. Two inflated modules remain absent at width twelve, giving nullity at least 10,677,394. Every quotient row occurs at width thirteen. **No new kappa** follows.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7c2dd1868c70f0addce2c0a4d3220149452f14b/research/clifford-four-qubit-threshold/PROOF.md), [all 81 multiplicities and finite certificates](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7c2dd1868c70f0addce2c0a4d3220149452f14b/research/clifford-four-qubit-threshold/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7c2dd1868c70f0addce2c0a4d3220149452f14b/research/clifford-four-qubit-threshold/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7c2dd1868c70f0addce2c0a4d3220149452f14b/research/clifford-four-qubit-threshold/SOURCE-PINS.json), [external mathematical inputs](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7c2dd1868c70f0addce2c0a4d3220149452f14b/research/clifford-four-qubit-threshold/EXTERNAL.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7c2dd1868c70f0addce2c0a4d3220149452f14b/research/clifford-four-qubit-threshold/CREDITS.md). This resolves and extends the width-ten question in [PR #7747](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7747).

| Width | Projective Gram result |
| --- | --- |
| 10 | Nullity at least 14,400 from a degree-120 Dickson block |
| 11 | Exact nullity 2,733,412,864; exact rank 12,125,935,463,936 |
| 12 | Nullity at least 10,677,394 |
| 13 and above | Full rank 12,128,668,876,800 |

The width-eleven quotient uses the conjugate natural representation and character `(-1)^d 2^(5d)`. Its only missing quotient rows are 9 and 22, of degrees 595 and 3213. At width twelve, the Pauli-invariant subspace is exactly that quotient, so the inflated copies of both rows remain absent. The width-thirteen quotient has character `(-1)^d 2^(6d)` and all 81 multiplicities positive. Schur products propagate full rank to every later width. Keeping the Gaussian phase and the correct natural/conjugate sector is necessary.

The published ordinary Sp(8,2) character table is a mathematical input. The CTblLib 1.3.11 archive and exact table member were SHA-256 authenticated; the unchanged source extractor rederived the complete retained projection. Every multiplicity is an exact nonnegative integer. Degree sums, two bin formulas and independent ten-/twelve-tuple orbit norms agree. These checks do not reconstruct the table from group multiplication.

A separate table-independent theorem gives `T(n)>=2n+3` for every positive n divisible by four. Every tuple stabilizer in the minus quadratic form contains a negative Dickson transvection. Inducing the actual Bell-line character times this sign gives an absent even-sector module. Its degree is `2^(n-1)(2^n-1)`. For n=4 it gives the width-ten block and explicit trace-based null coefficients, with identity coefficient 120.

Finite checks cover all 200,787 four-spaces and a separate singular-space census, 34,816 transvection point actions, 18,496 transvection pairs and all 14,400 sign products in a complete small orthogonal group. Literal checks cover 65,536 Pauli/Bell characters, 65,536 Bell inner products and 5,120 images under all twenty Clifford generators. Exterior-square traces agree with direct minors. Plus-type, longer-tuple, omitted-sign and changed-character controls distinguish the scope and the missing module.

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clifford-four-qubit-threshold
```

Both registered commands print:

```text
PASS_CLIFFORD_FOUR_QUBIT_THRESHOLD
Sharp threshold T(4)=13; width eleven nullity 2733412864; width twelve nullity >= 10677394
Width thirteen: all 81 quotient rows occur; full Gram rank 12128668876800
Four qubits at width ten: absent degree 120, nullity >= 14400, T(4) >= 11
200787 four-spaces; independent singular-space census 1,119,1071,765,0
65536 Pauli characters; 65536 Bell inner products; 5120 literal Clifford Bell images
Independent signed quotient sums: minus multiplicity 0, plus multiplicity 1
Written extension: T(n) >= 2n+3 for every positive n divisible by four
```

The [README](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/d7c2dd1868c70f0addce2c0a4d3220149452f14b/research/clifford-four-qubit-threshold/README.md) gives the optional source-archive command. That command also passed. The unchanged width-nine source checker, normal/optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44439548893/job/135276675627) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Nick Petalas (@petalas) supplied the [width-nine quotient proof](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff12ca358d601a21cd4b1f016b8a3a969ac44016/research/clifford-four-qubit-width-nine/README.md), [projection](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff12ca358d601a21cd4b1f016b8a3a969ac44016/research/clifford-four-qubit-width-nine/PROJECTION.json) and [unchanged checker](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff12ca358d601a21cd4b1f016b8a3a969ac44016/research/clifford-four-qubit-width-nine/verify.py). alephnan (@alephnan) supplied the [odd-sector and quadratic-character framework](https://github.com/alephnan/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f7f32a18dde54e67624a9ed9cc7e1b266d9585c0/research/clifford-three-qubit-threshold/PROOF.md) in [PR #6714](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6714), with its stated OpenAI Codex assistance and prior credit. Ali Romman (@aliromman) supplied the pointwise framework in [PR #5526](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5526). The character data credit the ATLAS and [Thomas Breuer’s CTblLib](https://www.math.rwth-aachen.de/~Thomas.Breuer/ctbllib/). The Dickson homomorphism is the classical [Taylor Theorem 11.43](https://www.maths.usyd.edu.au/u/don/papers/gcg.pdf#page=168).

The all-n Dickson statement is written mathematics with finite checks at n=4. No full four-qubit group, tensor matrix or trillion-entry null vector was materialized. Full even-sector nullities, other qubit congruence classes, sharp conditioning, native implementation and complete caller pricing remain open. The full three-qubit suite, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. All five framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged. No independent human/formal-kernel acceptance or global literature priority is claimed.

Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Seven retained files have exact pins; no unmerged ancestry is asserted.
